id: title:Silthus:hide quick start in the workflow editor header

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the desktop application UI, specifically the workflow header, to hide the product setup button based on workflow state.
review.reason: Adds a prop to hide a UI element and a corresponding test. This is a localized, bounded change to the desktop application's user interface. No systemic risk reduction or broader capability is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The exact workflow state triggering the hide behavior is not described in the provided observations, though the implementation and test suggest a specific conditional rendering. No broader adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change for WorkflowSceneHeader. P1.F2.H1 adds a prop hideProductSetupButton to WorkflowSceneHeader, while P1.F1.H4 adds a test asserting that the setup button is hidden. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H3 refactor the test setup. P1.F1.H1 adds imports. No score assigned.
